chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about how Allah perceives all things?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) to elucidate the concept of *al-Hasan* (the Good) as the exclusive domain of Divine perception, distinguishing it from human limited views. This highlights the Shia theological emphasis on *Adl* (Divine Justice), affirming that all occurrences, even those appearing adverse, are rooted in God's perfect wisdom and benevolence. It serves as a foundation for *Tawakkul* (trust in God), encouraging believers to perceive the underlying goodness in all divine decrees.
